results.note: A TLS handshake that fails inside a CONNECT or SOCKS tunnel is caught by UpstreamProxyRelayHandler.exceptionCaught, whatever the failure: one WARN 'SSL or decoder fault caught by upstream relay handler -> closing pipeline <channel>'. On SOCKS the 8.0.0 oracle sometimes also logs a port unification fault for its loopback connection (SNI mocked.example.test); that racy entry is masked away.
